user_query: How many labeled examples did DeepWalk use in the Flickr experiment at the 10% training-rate setting?
llm_response: In the Flickr experiment, the 10% training-rate setting corresponds to 10% of the labeled nodes being used for training. The Flickr dataset used in DeepWalk has 80,513 labeled examples (nodes), so 10% training means about 8,051 labeled examples were used.
llm_confidence_reasoning: This is based on the standard Flickr dataset size reported in DeepWalk-related experiments, but the exact count can depend on the specific preprocessing or split used in the paper.
